ns2:section.sectionText: This section is for continuing EOL students who began their Program of Study prior to the upcoming fall 2005 semester. Classes are scheduled from 7 PM to 10 PM on Aug. 26, Sept. 30, Nov. 4, Dec. 2, Jan. 20, March 3, and April 14. Individual conferences lasting approximately 30 minutes per student will be scheduled on Oct. 1, Nov. 5, Dec. 3, Jan. 21, March 4 and April 15. Academic Outreach restrictions and assessments apply, see http://www.outreach.uiuc.edu.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to CAS:Educ Org & Leadershp -UIUC or EDM:Educ Org & Leadershp -UIUC.
